newsitem.title: USA: D&P reaffirms Litton debt rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P reaffirms Litton debt rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Creidt rating Co said Tuesday it reaffirmed the triple-B-plus rating of the senior unsecured debt of Litton Industries Inc, an aerospace and defense contractor.
D&P noted Litton's announced policy of defense acquisitions. In fiscal 1996, Litton paid $648 million to acquire about $1 billion in sales.
Risks in the rating include the potential for higher leverage from acquisitions or share buyback. Also defense spending has been in a long term downtrend, D&P said in a statement.
Litton had outstanding funded debt of $764 million at July 31, 1996 representing 45.5 percent of invested capital.
